identified_as: Jenner-Boswell Joint High School (later Jenner-Boswell-Jennerstown), Boswell (Somerset County)
era: Merged 1969 with Forbes SD into North Star (green and white, Cougars); those are the successor's colours.
notes: Rex Collium yearbooks (1953-1960, e-yearbook OCR) call the teams the 'J.B.J. Bears' / 'Jenner-Boswell-Jennerstown Bears' (football, basketball, wrestling). No school colours stated; only class colours (1957 blue and black, 1959/1960 red and white), which are not used.
evidence: Read OCR text of 6 Rex Collium yearbooks: mascot Bears confirmed, no school colours, alma mater lyric without colours. No colour image looked at. North Star colours deliberately not used.

identified_as: New Cumberland High School, New Cumberland, Cumberland Co.
era: Merged 1959 with West Shore HS into Cedar Cliff (navy, gold and silver, Colts); New Cumberland's navy and gold carried into Cedar Cliff's colours.
notes: Cedar Cliff Wikipedia History section: 'West Shore's colors, navy blue and silver, would merge with New Cumberland's navy blue and gold'. Shawnee yearbooks (1951, 1953) call the teams the Tigers. 1954 yearbook says new caps and gowns 'represent the school colors, white for the girls, and blue for the boys' (blue confirmed; white only as gown colour).
evidence: No colour image looked at; names from Wikipedia history text, blue corroborated by 1954 Shawnee yearbook OCR. No hex.

identified_as: Northumberland High School, Northumberland, Northumberland Co.
era: Merged with Sunbury HS in 1965 to form Shikellamy (Braves; maroon, white, blue)
notes: No source for Northumberland HS colours or nickname found. 'Pineknotters Day' (started 1972 by Northumberland HS graduates) suggests 'Pineknotters' as the town/school nickname, unconfirmed as a team name; Sunbury yearbooks call the team 'Norry'.
evidence: Retry: 2 WebSearches, Sunbury La Vie 1955/1965 and Shikellamy 1985 yearbook OCR (merger history) read; none names Northumberland's colours. Nothing looked at with colour. Successor Shikellamy colours not used.

identified_as: Ashland High School, Ashland, Schuylkill Co.
era: Merged into North Schuylkill (Spartans; crimson red and royal blue) in the late 1960s/1970s
notes: Ardante yearbooks (e-yearbook OCR, 1941-1953) call the football team 'The Black Diamonds of 1951' / 'the Diamonds', and the school paper was The Black Diamond, so Black Diamonds is the school's nickname. No school colours stated; only class colours (blue and gold, blue and white, blue and silver, green and gold, red and gray), which vary by class and are not used.
evidence: Read OCR text of 8 Ardante yearbooks; nickname confirmed, no school colours. No colour image looked at. Successor North Schuylkill colours not used.

identified_as: Hughesville Junior/Senior High School, Hughesville (East Lycoming SD)
notes: Monarch yearbooks: 1953 and 1954 alma mater ends 'For our dear old Alma Mater And the Green and White', 1953 cheer 'Up with the colors ... Green and White!' and 'Green and White junior high squad'. The 1948 alma mater instead ended 'The Orange and the Blue', so the colours changed around 1950. Gold appears only as a modern district site accent; grey only as the logo helmet.
evidence: Yearbook OCR names Green and White (1953-54). East Lycoming SD Spartan helmet logo: dark green plume #324828 and grey helmet; site theme green #2C5418 dominant, gold #AC8400 accent. Green confirmed by both; white from yearbooks only, no hex.
